Class DataNode

java.lang.Object
io.github.moctave.weftspace.DataNode
Direct Known Subclasses:
LoadedNode
public class DataNode extends Object
A class representing a node in the data tree.

  • Constructor Details

    • DataNode

      public DataNode(@NonNull String name, @Nullable DataNode parent, @NonNull List<String> args, @NonNull List<DataNode> children)
      Primary constructor. Takes all the standard arguments, except those defined by LoadedNode.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of this node, typically the first phrase present on its line.
      parent - This node's parent node (or null if it should be the root of its tree).
      args - A list of arguments attached to this node.
      children - A list of nodes which are children of this node.

    • DataNode

      public DataNode()
      A simplified constructor that creates an empty node intended to be used as a root node for the DataReader.

  • Method Details

    • hashCode

      public int hashCode()
      Generates a hash code for this node, so that all nodes which are equal have the same hash code. Multiple distinct nodes may have the same hash code, as (1) the mechanics for name.hashCode() are not controlled, (2) parents are not taken into account in this method, and (3) nodes which have themself as a child will not have their children considered.
      Overrides:
      hashCode in class Object
      Returns:
      A hash code value for this node.

    • equals

      public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj)
      Indicates whether an object is equal to this node, comparing the names, arguments, and children of the two nodes. NOTE: Parents are NOT considered by this method, to reduce complexity. If you need to check if two nodes have identical parents, use sameParent(DataNode)
      Overrides:
      equals in class Object
      Parameters:
      obj - The object to compare this node against.
      Returns:
      true if this node is equal to obj, false otherwise.

    • sameParent

      public boolean sameParent(@NonNull DataNode node)
      Compares the parent of this node against another node to see if they are equal.
      Parameters:
      node - The node to compare this node against.
      Returns:
      true if this node has the same parent as the other node, false otherwise.
